artworks.title: The Delphic Sibyl
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural and sculptural elements with a central figure labeled "Delphica". The artwork features a seated draped figure at the center labeled "Delphica", positioned within an architectural arch. This figure is surrounded by smaller sculptural details of putti and mythical figures in niches, which decorate the cornices and spandrels of this grand architectural composition. The elaborate detailing includes symmetry and classical elements, such as pilasters and volutes. The shading technique adds depth and dimension to the figures and structural elements.

artworks.title: The Prophet Jeremiah
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a classical-style drawing with multiple figures. In the center is a seated man with a contemplative posture, featuring a beard, curly hair, and draped robes. He holds a ring. Other figures surround him: two smaller figures at each side, muscular nude male figures above, and a man with a staff and another seated man below. The background includes arches, pillars, and a pedestal labeled "HIEREMIAS" with a smaller supporting figure.

artworks.title: The Prophet Joel
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure in a classical architectural setting. The figure is sitting on an elevated platform with one foot resting flat and is holding a scroll. They wear draped garments and have short curly hair, looking intently at the scroll. Four smaller male figures surround the seated figure, appearing like statues with muscular builds and posed with hands above their heads. Other figures below seem to be interacting. The image has a label with the word "IOEL" and is framed by architectural elements like arches and columns. The background includes shaded areas and architectural details.

artworks.title: The Persian Sibyl
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural and sculptural composition. The artwork features a complex arrangement of figures and architectural elements, creating a symmetrical composition. Centered at the top is a seated, draped figure holding an open book, flanked by smaller nudes. The central figure is labeled "PERSICHA." Surrounding this central motif are additional figures in niches and archways, with nude figures posed in various positions. The drawing features intricate detailing and a focus on linework.

artworks.title: The Prophet Ezekiel
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex architectural structure with sculptural figures and ornamental elements. Two figures are seated on either side of a large decorative pedestal, adorned with smaller, nude figures in dynamic poses. The central seated figure on a higher pedestal has an authoritative posture, draped in flowing garments. The surrounding figures are detailed, showcasing attention to anatomy and movement. The composition is framed by ornate architectural elements like arches and columns, with a classical aesthetic reminiscent of renaissance styles.

artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The illustration shows three people in the foreground. The central figure is an older man with a bushy beard and mustache, sitting on a rocky outcrop. Next to him is a woman, and on his left is another woman pouring liquid from a jug into a cup that the man holds. The setting is outdoors surrounded by lush trees and foliage. In the distance, a smaller figure is seen walking. Objects like a walking stick, a jug, and fabric are at the bottom of the image, while the border is decorated with floral and scroll designs.

artworks.title: Fantastic Flowers with Peapod Leaves
artworks.medium: etching inked à la poupée in green, red, blue, purple, and golden brown on pale green paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image contains stylized floral and leaf patterns with intricate details. The color palette includes soft yellows, teal blues, muted reds, and browns against a light, neutral background. The flowers and leaves vary in size, with smaller clusters in the top left and larger motifs towards the bottom right.

artworks.title: Fantastic Flowers with Oyster-shell Blossoms
artworks.medium: etching inked à la poupée in green, blue, red, purple, golden brown, and yellow on pale green wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image contains large butterfly-like shapes in the lower half, with concentric patterns in shades of yellow, blue, and brown. Above are lush green fern leaves with red and pink clusters of flowers. The color palette includes green, yellow, brown, red, and pink. The butterflies are positioned lower in the image, while the ferns and flowers extend diagonally from left to top-right.

artworks.title: Veduta delle Terme di Tito
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection, acquired with assistance from The Morris and Gwendolyn Cafritz Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a top-down view of a landscape with ancient ruins among overgrown vegetation. Small figures are scattered among the ruins, reflecting scale and activity. The intricate and detailed style features precise etching strokes representing stone texture and nature reclaiming the structures. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes contrasts of black and white, enhancing the etching work and showcasing the dilapidated ruins merging with the landscape.

artworks.title: Veduta ... delle Terme di Tito
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection, acquired with assistance from The Morris and Gwendolyn Cafritz Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows the ruins of an ancient structure from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low, with distant hills and trees in the background. A large arch structure occupies the center, with ruined walls and arches extending to the left. Intricate etching techniques depict stone and foliage textures. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of brown and sepia. Fragments of sculptural forms and debris are scattered nearby, while small human figures can be seen in the distance. Nature appears to reclaim the architecture, conveying a sense of tranquil decay.

artworks.title: Alexander in the Studio of Apelles
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 45.5 x 27.5 cm (17 15/16 x 10 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five individuals around a painting on an easel. The central figure is standing, gesturing towards the painting, with curly hair and draped clothing. Two individuals are partially seated on the left, and two individuals in armor stand and sit on the right. There is a draped curtain in the upper left corner and a blank wall on the right with a Latin inscription at the bottom. A stool is placed below the canvas, and the setting appears to be an artist studio or a creative environment.

artworks.title: Hermit Thrush
artworks.medium: black chalk, watercolor, and gouache over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting depicts a bird perched on a portion of a branch in the center, surrounded by blank beige paper. The bird is facing the left, and it has brown plumage on its head and wings, white feathers with black spots on its chest, and a faint red color on its tail. The branch it is perched on is white with thin gray lines. At the bottom of the painting, there are a few lines of handwritten text.

artworks.title: Blue Yellow Back Warbler
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a painting of a blue bird perched on a flowering branch. The bird has a blue head, tail, and wings, with a white throat and body, both tinged with pink. Its beak is black with a hint of yellow. The bird is facing the right, standing on a branch with green leaves and partially open pink-purple flowers. The background is beige paper, and there are some written lines of text at the bottom of the painting.

artworks.title: English Black Cocks
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 46.3 x 68.3 cm (18 1/4 x 26 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: A Couple Seated on the Beach with Two Dogs
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Ladies and Gentleman Walking on the Beach with Two Dogs
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a painting of a social gathering in an outdoor setting. Two figures are central to the composition, facing each other, one dressed in a dark outfit and the other in a long dress with red accents. The background features additional figures. A couple of dogs are also present. The use of light strokes and subtle colors gives the piece a delicate quality. This painting resembles the style of John Singer Sargent, with its graceful depiction of everyday life.

artworks.title: Beach House with Flags at Trouville
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows a gathering of people on a sandy area. The people are dressed in dark clothing and hats, some holding parasols. They are painted in broad, overlapping brushstrokes and have few visible details. Past the crowd of people, the horizon separates the sandy ground from the pale blue sky, with a strip of blue water in between. On the right, there is a small building or tent with a triangular roof and two flags on top, one of which is the French flag. There is another flagpole with the same two flags on the left, behind the tent. On the far right, there are more buildings and some green trees. The painting has loose and fluid brushstrokes, giving it an impressionistic quality.

artworks.title: Ladies and Gentlemen Seated on the Beach with a Dog
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows six individuals in various poses. One person stands to the left, wearing a dark suit and a hat. In the center, three individuals sit with their backs to the viewer: a woman in a blue dress and hat, and two men in dark suits and hats. On the right, two individuals are seated, one more distinctly drawn than the other. A dog with a white and brown coat stands near the standing man, looking at the seated group. The background is plain with minimal details.

artworks.title: Ladies and Gentlemen on the Beach, in Two Registers
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows two scenes of social gatherings with multiple people. One scene has individuals seated in period clothing from the 19th century, while the other scene shows people sitting and standing, also dressed in period attire. The focus is on the figures and their interactions in what appears to be a public space, with minimal background details. The colors are soft and muted, possibly indicating a watercolor painting.

artworks.title: Two Ladies Seated and a Couple Walking on the Beach
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a watercolor painting depicting four individuals. Two individuals are standing on the left, while two others are seated on the right. One standing person is a man, looking leftward at a woman standing beside him. The man is wearing a black suit and a hat. The woman is facing the man and is wearing a white dress with a blue accent and a matching hat with a blue veil. On the right, two seated women are wearing long dresses and hats, with one in a brown dress and a colorful hat, and the other wearing a dark dress with a yellow shawl. Details of their faces and hair are minimal, and they are set against a light background.

artworks.title: A Couple Seated and a Couple Walking on the Beach
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a scene captured from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is placed low in the composition, with ample space given to the sky above, which has cloudy textures. On the horizon line, faint suggestions of the sea are visible. In the foreground, four elegantly dressed figures are depicted. Two are seated, one in a red shawl and the other in a dark coat with a parasol. The other two stand nearby, also holding parasols. The brushwork is loose and expressive, and the color palette consists of earth tones and soft pastels with occasional pops of red.

artworks.title: Four Ladies Seated at Trouville
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite with black chalk over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows four people: three women sitting on chairs and one man standing on the right. The women are wearing long dresses with different styles and accessories. Some have their hair up and wear hats or pins, and two women wear shawls. The man is standing in a coat and cap, with his hands in his pockets. In the background, there is a soft, muted ambiance with faint outlines of ships or masts in a broad open space.

artworks.title: Four Ladies in Crinolines Walking at Trouville
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a watercolor sketch of four women walking in a line from left to right. They are depicted in a side profile with indistinct facial features. The two women on the left wear light-colored dresses with red and lavender accents, one with a red ribbon. The two women on the right wear darker clothes, one with a dark coat and the other in a blue dress with a black and white striped bottom. The background is plain with a light texture, likely the color of the paper used.

artworks.title: The Black Hat
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing is a portrait showing the upper half of a woman's body. She is positioned facing us, her head turned slightly to the right. Her facial features include pale skin, blue eyes, thin eyebrows, a long nose, and pink lips in a calm expression. Her brown hair is partially hidden under a large, black, feathered hat. She is dressed in a light blue outfit with puffed sleeves and a high collar with black trim. The background is a simple, muted grayish-brown color.
